description: React component for a customizable quick input field with clear button and tooltip support, used within Mattermost's web application.

classes.name: QuickInput
classes.description: A React memoized functional component that renders an input with optional clear button and tooltip, supporting controlled and uncontrolled usage.

methods.name: setInputRef
methods.description: Callback to set the input reference, supporting forwarded refs.

methods.name: onClear
methods.description: Handler to clear the input when the clear button is clicked.
